options: A backup artifact needs checksum and protection, but recoverability is proven only by a separate-target restore plus smoke/data verification.

answer: A backup artifact needs checksum and protection, but recoverability is proven only by a separate-target restore plus smoke/data verification.
explanation: Logical PostgreSQL backup serializes database schema/data through pg_dump. A cryptographic checksum detects accidental artifact corruption/change but does not establish recoverability by itself. Backup policy defines location, permissions, retention, restore target and verification drill.
